title: The new Samsung SmartTag3 supports iOS, it's also smaller and its battery lasts longer
description: The Samsung SmartTag2 is three years old now and was due for an upgrade. This is the first generation that is cross-platform – it works with both Android and iOS devices. It’s also smaller and lighter, though that came at a cost. New wireless tech allowed Samsung to improve detection range and to extend battery life. The Samsung SmartTag3 can now be used by iPhone owners – this makes it easier if you have Android and iOS devices in your family or if a friend or family member wants to borrow, say, a suitcase with a tag attached. title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+ debut
description: Samsung has unveiled its latest flagship Android tablets, the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+. The tablets will go on sale in select markets starting October 7. The new Galaxy Tab S12 series tablets share several specifications, although the Ultra model gets a larger display, more RAM and storage, a bigger battery, and a couple of other upgrades over the Plus model. Both the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+ are powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset and run Android 17-based OneUI 9. It gets a multi-window layout with up to three sections, the latest Galaxy...

title: Oppo F35 series pricing leaked ahead of India launch
description: Ahead of their launch in India next week, the prices of the Oppo F35 and F35 Pro have leaked online. The Oppo F35 series is confirmed to feature a 50MP ultrawide front camera with a 100 degree field-of-view. According to the leak, the Oppo F35 will start at INR 37,999 for the 6GB/128GB variant. The phone is tipped to feature a 6.57 inch AMOLED display, a Dimensity 6360 chipset, and a 50MP primary rear camera paired with a 2MP depth sensor. Meanwhile, the Oppo F35 Pro could be priced between INR 44,000 and INR 50,000 for the base variant with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of...

title: Google Pixel 11a CAD-based renders leak showing more of the same
description: Back in July, purported specs for the upcoming Google Pixel 11a leaked, and today we have some CAD-based renders of the device to look at. The source of these renders also confirms one of the key upgrades that were also mentioned in the aforementioned specs leak, namely that the Pixel 11a will be powered by the Tensor G6 chipset, just like the rest of the Pixel 11 devices. The Pixel 11a is reportedly going to be unveiled next spring, so we're still very far from its release. Anyway, as you can see, the Pixel 11a looks eerily similar to the Pixel 10a, which itself was almost identical...

title: iQOO Pad Ultra is here for gamers with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, built-in fan
description: iQOO's gaming-focused small tablet is now official. Meet the iQOO Pad Ultra. It comes with an 8.8-inch AMOLED screen with 2304x1440 resolution (for a 16:10 aspect ratio), a 165Hz refresh rate, and 4,500-nit peak local brightness (peak full-screen brightness is 1,600 nits). Like the iQOO 16, which also launched today, the iQOO Pad Ultra is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. iQOO has also packed its self-developed Q4 gaming chip into the tablet, as well as its Wi-Fi enhancement chip. The device comes with an active cooling fan too. iQOO Pad Ultra official...

title: Tecno Pova 8 Pro and Pova 8 Pro Tonino Lamborghini unboxing and hands-on
description: Say hello to the Tecno Pova 8 Pro, or should we maybe say the Pova 8 Pros, as we've got two in the office. The regular Pova 8 Pro is joined by the very exclusivePova 8 Pro Tonino Lamborghini special edition. We're going to unbox both, and show you arguably the weirdest thing we've had as part of a smartphone package we've seen yet. One important distinction before we continue: this isn't the car maker Lamborghini but the lifestyle and design brand Tonino Lamborghini. title: vivo X Fold6 European listing reveals its price and specs
description: vivo launched the X Fold6 in China a few months ago, and yesterday a tipster on X claimed to reveal when it will be landing in India as well as other global markets. Today we have the device showing up in listings on the website of an Italian online retailer. These listings show a price of €2,135.90, but this retailer has never actually revealed RRPs before - those will clearly be €2,199.99 or similar. Anyway, the ballpark has now been outed, at least. title: Apple Pay is now available in India
description: Twelve years after first launching its payment service in the US, Apple has finally brought Apple Pay to India, although the service is currently limited to select bank cards. Apple Pay is available to users in India across Apple devices, except Mac, although support for macOS is confirmed to be coming soon. The payment service currently supports Visa and Mastercard credit cards issued by Axis Bank. Users can add their cards to Apple Wallet and use tap-to-pay at thousands of in-store merchants or make online payments. Apple Pay also supports NFC transactions. In an official press...

title: vivo V80 price in India leaks along with full specs
description: vivo is launching the V80 in India on October 6. Ahead of that, today a tipster on X has seemingly revealed the phone's pricing for the Indian market. So without further ado, let's dive right in. The device is said to start at 128GB of storage for INR 63,000 ($657). If you want 256GB, you'll pay INR 70,000 ($730). The top of the line version with 512GB of storage will cost INR 80,000 ($834). title: Huawei Mate 90 series key specs leaked ahead of launch
description: We recently got our first look at Huawei’s upcoming Mate 90 lineup, and a tipster has now revealed the key specifications of all four models. Huawei has confirmed that it will launch the Mate 90 series in China on October 1. In a post on Weibo, tipster Digital Chat Station has revealed the chipsets powering the Mate 90 series. Huawei Mate 90 Pro leaked renders According to the tipster, the base Mate 90 will be powered by the Kirin 9030 chipset, while the Mate 90 Pro is said to feature the Kirin 9035 SoC. title: The Honor Life S3 is a 3.7" ebook reader that attaches to the back of your phone with magnets
description: Recently, there has been a trend of add-on displays that magnetically attach to the back of your phone. Normally, they are used as preview displays for the camera, but Honor is going another way – what if your phone could carry an ebook reader? The Honor Life S3 is a tiny reader – it has a 3.68” e-ink display with 259ppi pixel density. The whole thing measures 5.6mm thick and weighs 61g. title: Our Redmi Note 17 5G battery life and charging tests are ready
description: Xiaomi’s Redmi Note series still features a 4G model despite most of the world having transitioned to 5G. We have both the Redmi Note 17 5G and the 4G variant and ran battery and charging tests on them. In this post, we’ll focus on the 5G model and in the next one, we’ll see what the 4G one has to offer. The Redmi Note 17 5G is nearly identical to its 4G sibling – the only difference is the chipset. For 5G connectivity, Xiaomi picked the 4nm Snapdragon 4 Gen 4. title: British court renews an antitrust lawsuit involving Apple and Amazon
description: In 2023, Apple and Amazon were hit with a class action lawsuit over a 2018 agreement between the two companies that restricts third-party retailers from selling Apple and Beats products on Amazon. This means the two companies engage in antitrust practices that limit competition and ultimately raise prices for the consumers. This is not the first time Amazon and Apple have faced scrutiny over this particular deal. The two giants were already hit with similar cases in Germany, the USA, Spain and Italy. Christine Riefa, a consumer law academic, led the case, but the British Competition...

description: AI agents from OpenAI have been on a hacking spree – they hacked into Hugging Face, later it came out that they also attacked Modal Labs and last week it was revealed that agents had hacked several sites run by the Australian government. The hack happened in June, but it is only now coming to light. Here are the affected sites: Services Australia: an OpenAI model gained access, ran commands and even retrieved internal files. title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra vs. Samsung Galaxy Z Fold7
description: So, you're eyeing a new Samsung foldable but would rather stick with the more traditional and established form factor than go for the new Z Fold8. In that case, the phone you're looking for is now called the Z Fold8 Ultra. Unlike the Z Fold8, though, which genuinely brings a new shape with few direct alternatives on the market, the same can't quite be said for the Z Fold8 Ultra. description: A few hours ago leaks brought us our first look at Huawei’s upcoming Mate90 series, including the Mate90 RS, and now the company has finally officially acknowledged the lineup. title: HMD Vibe2 Pro debuts with a 64MP rear camera, 6.78-inch display
description: HMD has debuted its latest Vibe series smartphone in India. The new Vibe2 Pro comes with features such as a 6,000mAh battery and a 64MP main rear camera. The HMD Vibe2 Pro is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and sports a 6.78-inch LCD display that offers Full-HD+ resolution and a refresh rate of 120Hz. At the back, the handset offers a 64MP main camera using the Sony IMX682 sensor. It’s paired with a 2MP macro camera. The phone also features a 13MP camera at the front for selfies and video calls. description: Today the iQOO 16 has become official in China as the brand's latest flagship smartphone. It comes with a 6.85-inch Samsung-made M16 AMOLED display with 1440x3168 resolution, a 19.8:9 aspect ratio, and a 165Hz refresh rate. description: Huawei unveiled a new MatePad Air tablet in China today, dubbed MatePad Air Z. It comes in two versions, with a standard edition MatePad Air Z joined by an Enjoy Edition. For the most part, the two versions share nearly identical specs, with some minor differences in the display, chipset and charging speed departments.
